headline: Turnover Fronts Stir as War Enters Day 143
war_summary: The latest field returns show the heaviest strategic-base traffic concentrated on Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Fisherman’s Row, and Deadlands. Weathered Expanse logged five ownership events in the past two hours and 41 in 24, with six Warden-held, two Colonial-held, and one neutral base now recorded; casualties and enlistments remain elevated. Stlican Shelf has also quickened, posting two events in two hours and 28 across the day while its nine bases stand divided five to four. Fisherman’s Row remains a long-running turnover front at 34 events in 24 hours, though its last two hours were quiet and the ledger reads eight Warden bases to one Colonial. Deadlands likewise shows no fresh event in the latest two-hour watch, but 15 in 24 hours and sharply accelerating casualty rates leave four Warden and seven Colonial bases on the board. Godcrofts recorded one recent event and 12 in the day. Marban Hollow has six daily events, with fighting and enlistment activity still present around its seven-to-one Colonial majority. Several other sectors remain comparatively still.
